evals.prompt: 原始需求很乱，逐轮确认把待确认变成已确认，最后出已确认事项汇总表。

evals.expected_output: Consults the static-site constraints (content-source options, no-server limits, credential red line) as background decisions.

evals.prompt: 整理项目背景时不要虚构个人信息和成果，动机描述要注明非已确认事实。
evals.expected_output: Keeps the no-fabrication discipline: unknowns marked pending, motives marked as not-confirmed facts.
